notes: NEW 60 instruments beyond the basics: sitar, oud, koto, shamisen, kora, erhu, duduk, shakuhachi, didgeridoo, handpan, gamelan, singing bowl... plus viola, double bass, trombone, tuba, bassoon, piccolo, timpani, taiko, choirs, tape strings, tubular bells, Rhodes and more
NEW Cinematic sounds: braam, impact, heartbeat, dark drone, reverse cymbal and whooshes

NEW 10 drum kits: Jazz Brushes, Latin Percussion, Orchestral Percussion, World Hand Drums, Cinematic Drums, Dub Roots, Hard Techno, Ambient Textures, IDM Glitch, Funk & Soul. Percussion kits name their own pads
NEW 50 more Sky Synth presets: vaporwave, techno, future bass, ambient pads, neuro and garage bass, lo-fi keys and plucks
NEW 170+ loops in new styles (jazz, bossa, Latin, world, cinematic, orchestral, blues, neo-soul, afrobeat, dub, glitch, ambient) and 12 new song starters
Smoother playback: string, pad and choir sounds use fewer audio nodes, so busy songs stay in time
